newsitem.title: USA: Amoco buying blendstocks, not Gulf gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Amoco buying blendstocks, not Gulf gasoline.

text.p: Amoco Corp has been buying blendstocks in the U.S. Gulf spot market and selling conventional grade gasoline, according to traders and an Amoco source.
Talk that Amoco purchases helped boost conventional (M1) gasoline differentials on the USG are not accurate, according to the Amoco source.
"That's not true, we've been selling the M1s today," the source said.
Traders said there was talk that Amoco had an operational problem at one of its refineries but the company and the source would not comment on the status of its units.
U.S. Gulf conventional M1 gasoline differentials firmed about 0.40 cent from Tuesday's levels to sit between 3.35 to 3.50 cents under the NYMEX June gasoline futures.
However, Amoco was seen buying alkylates, or high-octane gasoline blendstocks, on the U.S. Gulf, according to market players.
